tags.name: param

props.name: toLocaleString
props.type: { (locales?: string | string[] | undefined, options?: NumberFormatOptions | undefined): string; (locales?: LocalesArgument, options?: NumberFormatOptions | undefined): string; }
props.documentation: Converts a number to a string by using the current or specified locale.

tags.name: param
tags.text: locales A locale string or array of locale strings that contain one or more language or locale tags. If you include more than one locale string, list them in descending order of priority so that the first entry is the preferred locale. If you omit this parameter, the default locale of the JavaScript runtime is used.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options An object that contains one or more properties that specify comparison options.

tags.name: param
tags.text: locales A locale string, array of locale strings, Intl.Locale object, or array of Intl.Locale objects that contain one or more language or locale tags. If you include more than one locale string, list them in descending order of priority so that the first entry is the preferred locale. If you omit this parameter, the default locale of the JavaScript runtime is used.

tags.name: param
tags.text: options An object that contains one or more properties that specify comparison options.

props.name: toPrecision
props.documentation: Returns a string containing a number represented either in exponential or fixed-point notation with a specified number of digits.

tags.name: param
tags.text: precision Number of significant digits. Must be in the range 1 - 21, inclusive.
